brief:
A suppressed American document prepared by officials in Jerusalem and Washington exposed internal disagreement within President Donald Trump's administration over how to respond to escalating Israeli settlement expansion in the occupied West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The undisclosed memo, which was never published, addressed conflicting approaches to handling the issue at a time when European governments were taking positions on settlements.

The existence of the buried statement indicates divisions between US policymakers on settlement policy during the Trump presidency, particularly regarding coordination with or response to European decisions on the matter.

title: Unpublished US memo reveals Trump administration rift over West Bank settlements
